integrity: Complete mathematical proof from exhaustive RREF classification and an exact Frobenius polynomial; standalone finite-field checks are supporting rather than an infinite-degree proof.
limitations: Only the three F3-rational specializations are considered; geometric line incidence, surface zeta functions, and full Picard lattices are not determined. The external historical-priority assessment is best-knowledge rather than independently certified.
title: Frobenius eight-cycles on the lines of a characteristic-three quartic K3 pencil
